propositions: Wire three AI client configs (Copilot, Codex, Claude) to connect to rebar MCP HTTP endpoint using static bearer token authentication from environment variables
Each client requires a different config file location and format (Copilot JSON, Codex TOML, Claude JSON) but all use the same bearer token auth mechanism
Configuration must reference credentials from gitignored files or environment variables, never storing PAT secrets inline in committed examples
Provide example configs under examples/mcp-clients/ plus setup documentation linking to existing runbook and credential provisioning model
Acceptance criteria include hermetic testing with local loopback rebar-mcp instance, validation of real tool calls, 401 rejection on invalid bearer, and confirmation no PAT literals are committed
